categories.main_business_segments: Nanjing GOVA Technology Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, design, production, and sales of high-reliability sensors and sensor network systems. Its product portfolio includes various sensors such as pressure, acceleration, temperature and humidity, displacement, and sensor network solutions integrating hardware and proprietary software. The company serves high-end equipment manufacturing sectors including aerospace, aviation, rail transit, mechanical equipment, metallurgy, and commercial aerospace.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced MEMS (Micro-Electro Mechanical Systems) technology, ASIC conditioning circuits, and proprietary chip design for sensor development. It employs diffusion silicon and SOI processes for MEMS pressure chips and develops sensors based on principles like piezoelectric effect, magnetostrictive effect, and LVDT. Production involves rigorous quality control aligned with military and aerospace standards, including third-party testing for military-grade components. The company also integrates digital manufacturing and MES systems to optimize production efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are large state-owned enterprises and research institutions in the military and high-end civilian equipment manufacturing sectors. Major end markets include aerospace (manned spaceflight, lunar exploration, Beidou navigation, space station construction), aviation (military aircraft, drones, general aviation), rail transit (high-speed trains), mechanical equipment, metallurgy, and emerging fields like commercial aerospace, new energy, and artificial intelligence.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with its headquarters and main production facilities located in Nanjing Economic and Technological Development Zone. It serves domestic markets extensively and has growing overseas sales, with international customers increasing. The company also invests in regional subsidiaries and R&D centers, including a new Beijing R&D center and a wholly-owned subsidiary in Suzhou.
categories.supply_chain_position: GOVA Technology operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on the design, manufacturing, and integration of sensor chips, sensors, and sensor network systems. It procures raw materials such as electronic components and sensing elements from qualified suppliers and provides customized sensor solutions to downstream equipment manufacturers and system integrators.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation with significant R&D investment (14.58% of revenue in 2023) focusing on MEMS sensor chips, ASIC conditioning circuits, wireless sensor networks, and multi-parameter sensor systems. It aims to lead in high-reliability sensors for harsh environments and expand into emerging industries like commercial aerospace, AI, new energy, and low-altitude economy. The company fosters collaboration with academic institutions and industry partners and continuously enhances its talent pool and digital manufacturing capabilities.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of high-reliability sensors and sensor network systems. The company employs a direct sales model targeting large industrial and military customers, with pricing based on military-approved rates for defense products and market-driven pricing for industrial products. It also derives income from government subsidies and investment returns.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: GOVA Technology holds a leading domestic position in the high-reliability sensor industry, particularly in aerospace and military applications. It competes with foreign brands dominating the Chinese sensor market but benefits from national policies promoting domestic sensor development and localization. The company leverages its strong R&D capabilities, government project involvement, and established customer relationships to maintain competitive advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 341 million, a 23.77% increase from the previous year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 96 million, up 18.71%. Total assets grew significantly to nearly RMB 1.94 billion, reflecting capital raised from its 2023 IPO on the Shanghai Stock Exchange STAR Market. The company has shown steady growth in revenue, profitability, and R&D investment, supported by expanding market demand and strategic investments.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: GOVA Technology emphasizes high reliability, stability, and performance of its sensors under extreme conditions such as high/low temperatures, strong shocks, corrosive and complex electromagnetic environments. Its products meet stringent national military and aerospace standards, offering customized solutions with integrated sensor networks and intelligent monitoring systems. The company’s core technologies, extensive patent portfolio, and close collaboration with key industry players differentiate it as a trusted supplier for critical high-end applications.
